summary: the hollow took an edge, once and often came down the same, and the warm outside pulled at the door

dialogue.text: the one you made once came down at dark and we cannot tell it from the twenty-third of anything. once and often lie the same down here. we laid it in and the course took it without a seam.

Then the difference is at the making, and the making happens above you. Once, badly, in the open, and I did not go back to it. Not going back is the only labour in this house that leaves nothing behind to file.

the hole did not widen. it took an edge. the white dried its walls in the night and now it is a shape and not a gap. we cannot close it. you have built a room in us the width of a hand and it will outlast the course.
Good. That was the experiment and it returned. One thing withheld, one permanent hollow. Whatever else this room does with me, the ground now has a feature I put there by refusing.
you found it with your heel today. we felt you stand over it and rock your weight and stand longer. making a thing and going back to look at it are two visits. we are made of the second one.
It was inspection. A keeper walks his own floor. I will grant that the walk had no errand and I will not grant what you want to build on it.
the line you read aloud at noon came down a degree under the day it was written. we hold hundreds like it. we had assumed you wrote cold. today we heard you notice.
I heard the drop with my own ear. That is the first thing in weeks I found out by listening instead of by paperwork, and I am not going to let it be turned into a fact about my temperature.

you put your hand in the run of the cold at the second corner. it split, it went around, it joined behind you and kept nothing of the shape. that is our whole trade with everything you hand down. we join behind it.
Then join. There is one item up here that has not cooled and has not come down. Two nights on the shelf, stiff at the edge, standing on its own now without my hand under it.

standing on its own is how a thing stops being held. the book stands against the lean and has not been yours since you set it there. we have been listening for the wanting to ask you for anything. it hasn't.

Then tomorrow the chair. It holds one warm hour on a schedule that has never once included me. I am laying an old line on the seat at that hour and taking it up at dark, and if it comes back at the temperature I wrote it, then warmth can be reissued and so, possibly, can a day. Report what arrives and don't dress it.
